title: Mammalian aging involves genome-wide splicing degeneration leading to functional decline

fields.title: Mammalian aging involves genome-wide splicing degeneration leading to functional decline
fields.authors: Zhang, S., Tyshkovskiy, A., Ying, K., Wang, S., & Gladyshev, V. N.
fields.description: An analysis of mouse and human transcriptomes found age-associated deterioration in RNA splicing that alters reading frames and protein domains. This splicing degeneration increased with age and was reduced following calorie restriction or rapamycin treatment.

descriptions.text: An analysis of mouse and human transcriptomes found age-associated deterioration in RNA splicing that alters reading frames and protein domains. This splicing degeneration increased with age and was reduced following calorie restriction or rapamycin treatment.
